stories.title: Sale of Rep. Stefanik family’s D.C. home deemed ‘unusual,’ city records show
stories.summary: A rowhome owned by the outgoing congresswoman’s family was taken off the market after failing to sell for $1.99 million — and then sold in a private transaction for $910,000 more than that.

stories.title: Top Nvidia chips are still being sold in China, despite U.S. ban
stories.summary: Though black-market prices have surged amid the turmoil around Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, traders in Shenzhen persist in hawking the company’s best chips.

stories.title: Sticker shock looms as major challenge for single-payer health care push
stories.summary: Any discussion of a universal health plan in the U.S. always comes with concerns about massive costs. Americans already spend more than $5 trillion on health care each year.

stories.title: 300,000 legal immigrants told they’re losing Medicare coverage
stories.summary: A law restricting eligibility for the federal health insurance program is set to leave thousands of immigrant seniors without benefits.

stories.title: Libyan army vows retaliation after 2 naval officers die of wounds from Ukrainian drone attack
stories.summary: The attack occurred Sunday at the Benghazi Naval Base, where a Russian warship was refueling.

stories.title: Miss Manners: My ex left me for another man years ago, but it still hurts and is making wedding planning for my daughter difficult
stories.summary: Advice from Judith Martin, Nicholas Ivor Martin and Jacobina Martin.

stories.title: Dear Annie: My husband assumes I’ll do all the household chores now that I’m retired

stories.title: Signs of danger at Iowa plant emerged months before Army says it knew, emails show
stories.summary: The exchange conflicts with the Army’s account of events leading up to Wednesday’s planned detonation.

stories.title: Kilmar Abrego Garcia, who fought his mistaken deportation, voluntarily leaves U.S. for Spain
stories.summary: The Salvadoran migrant was illegally deported to his home country, then brought back to the U.S. and threatened with deportation to African countries.

stories.title: Opinion: Why is no one celebrating the state’s record of only one API patient grievance in 8 years?
